title: General
name: Leofric
description: The General is a giant of a man, gentle and slow to anger, and loved by his soldiers as few commanders are. He is devout and honourable, and never truly off duty, working long into every night so that nothing fails on his watch. What he cannot bring himself to do is be hard on the men he loves.
history: The General is a younger son of a good house, noble enough that his first commission came easily, though he earned every rank after it. He commands the northern front from his Keep, and when the Fall ended the generations-long war with Ostvengr, his army was left with little to do. He long defended the future Drillmaster against his many critics, valuing the bluntness he often needed, until he could defend him no longer and had to send him to the Capital. Without him and the threat of war, the army has grown lax, and the General has let it.
summary: A gentle, devout and tireless General, beloved by his soldiers, who commands a quiet frontier and has let his army grow comfortable.

appearance.features: Broad, kindly face and heavy-lidded, tired eyes

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Heavy plate armour over a surcoat bearing the Bastion

notes: Speaks softly and slowly, pausing to think before he answers, and phrases his orders as requests
Is always tired: yawns behind his hand, blinks heavily, and dozes in his chair after long nights over reports
Keeps a chaplain at his side, prays before every decision, and attends services with his men
Writes a fine, careful hand, a gentleman's accomplishment he still practises, and uses it to write to the family of every soldier lost under his command
